title: Scenario-driven guidelines and migration notes for tokens, buttons, tables & charts
creator: Ava Morgan
description: Create a scenario-driven documentation module that helps engineers and designers migrate from legacy design tokens and primitive components to the updated semantic tokens and composed components. The goal is a short, practical set of migration scenarios (surface-level, dense-data, and interactive controls) with live snippets, rationale, do/don't examples, and a compact conversion matrix so teams can move incrementally without regressions. Focus areas: token renames and mapping, button variants & touch areas, table density & responsive patterns, and chart color/contrast migrations.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Documentation contains at least 4 migration scenarios: Surface (cards, panels), Dense Tables, Interactive Controls (buttons, toggles), and Charts with color tokens.
A2: Each scenario has: rationale, step-by-step migration checklist, before/after screenshots, code snippets, and test guidance (visual + unit).
A3: Conversion matrix mapping legacy tokens to semantic tokens published in the doc and linked as CSV/JSON in Drive.
A4: Figma component kit updated with new tokens and a short ‘how to replace’ layer that mirrors doc examples.
A5: Docs reviewed by Eng and PM and signed off in the PR (two approvers).
tasks: Task 1: Draft scenario narratives and migration checklist (owner: Ava)
Task 2: Capture before/after screenshots for each scenario (owner: Liam)
Task 3: Add code snippets for React + Vanilla CSS examples and small test harnesses (owner: EngDocs)
Task 4: Create conversion matrix CSV and upload to Drive (owner: DataKit)
Task 5: Run chromatic snapshots and add visual test notes (owner: QA)
Task 6: Open docs PR and request reviews from PM & Eng leads (owner: Liam)
design_notes: Emphasize the semantic token approach: use tokens named for 'surface', 'accent', 'text-high', 'ui-muted' rather than color codes.
Provide a tiny decision flow for choosing button variants (primary, secondary, ghost) based on intent and density.
For tables, include density presets (compact, standard, comfortable) with explicit row height and spacing values tied to tokens.
Charts: recommend pairing semantic tokens with a guaranteed contrast layer and fallback palette for low-color contexts.
migration_checklist: Inventory: list components that reference legacy tokens
Mapping: apply conversion matrix to each component, record changes in a migration log
Visual test: run snapshot comparison and resolve token-driven deltas
Behavior test: validate hit targets for buttons and interactive states
Release: roll out docsite change behind a toggle and announce in dev-channel
code_snippets_examples:
// Compact table CSS variables
.table--compact { --row-height: var(--space-6); font-size: 13px; }

// Button variant mapping (JS)
const variantMap = { primary: 'btn-primary', subtle: 'btn-ghost' };

risk_and_mitigation: Risk: Token rename causes visual regressions in product pages. Mitigation: snapshot tests and a canary rollout for the first week.
Risk: Component APIs diverge during migration. Mitigation: include compatibility shims and document a deprecation window.
accessibility_considerations: Ensure chart color pairs meet WCAG AA for text-equivalent overlays or provide a high-contrast toggle.
Buttons must maintain 44x44px touch target in compact modes; document recommended minimum and tests.
